item.title: I think distracted drivers should get stiffer fines
item.description: "Everyone is always complaining about the traffic here. I think things would be better if people on their phones got stiff fines (GPS being an exemption). You can spot them a mile away by their driving, it's slower than the flow and weaving in their lane. This can cause aggression to get away from them. item.title: I also think infrastructure in Ocala has to keep pace with development
item.description: "I have 42 years of experience in the trades. My experience is also in road construction. If a developer wants to build housing or whatever, make them put in traffic lights and proper turning lanes in return for approval of projects. I agree, you have to keep infrastructure paced with development. Ocala supervisors are not a rubber stamp for development." - An Ocala resident shares an opinion. Read more: I also think infrastructure in Ocala has to keep pace with development
